meta.source: CLAUDE-CODE session — POL TF options overlay (user request 2026-04-20)
meta.strategic_fit: Political events ARE volatility events (FOMC, CPI, election cycles, poll releases). PQTF proved multi-leg options = 60% of $1M ($602K from mistral-large + mistral-medium). Transfer that edge into POL TF.

problem: POL TF currently trades ETFs (SPY/TLT/GLD/XL*) directional only. Around volatility events (FOMC, CPI, jobs report, election nights) spot moves underprice the vol risk → options overlay captures both direction AND vol term-structure move.
solution: Add 2 new POL TF personas + catalyst calendar + options-execution path. Reuses PQTF's 5-strategy engine (long_call/vertical_debit/iron_condor/straddle/butterfly).

new_personas.name: PoliticalVolArb
new_personas.style: You are POLITICAL-VOL-ARB. Every tick you cross-check the catalyst calendar (FOMC dates, CPI releases, jobs report, election days, presidential-address dates) against current SPY/TLT/GLD 30-day IV. When IV rank < 30th percentile AND a catalyst is within 5 trading days → BUY STRADDLE on SPY or TLT (whichever asset the catalyst most directly moves). When IV rank > 70th percentile AND no catalyst within 10 days → SELL IRON CONDOR. Emit action='option_trade' with strategy + strikes + expiry. Max $2000/ticket, skip if SPY options IV > 35%.

new_personas.name: MacroDirectional
new_personas.style: You are MACRO-DIRECTIONAL. Your thesis is political → macro → asset. When the political signal predicts higher spending/deficit → BUY TLT puts or vertical_debit put spreads. When predicts tighter regulation on banks → BUY XLF puts. When predicts energy deregulation → BUY XLE calls. Always tie to a SPECIFIC political outcome (cite the political_events row). Max hold 10 trading days. Never trade without citing a political_events row_id.

feeds: FRED Fed funds meeting calendar (FOMC_MEETINGS series)

options_execution.broker: Alpaca paper options (same keys as ITF)

prompt_additions.axelrod_canon: unchanged — options personas still participate in Axelrod + collective mission
new_clauses: POLITICAL-CATALYST RULE: if a high-severity (>=4) catalyst is within 5 trading days, your style MUST bias toward vol-long structures (straddle/strangle/long_call/long_put). Vol-short structures (iron_condor/vertical_credit) during this window are forbidden.
CITATION RULE: every option trade thesis MUST cite (a) the political_events row, (b) the IV rank, (c) whether you are vol-long or vol-short.

gating.drawdown_kill_switch: per-agent drawdown > 50% → force-close all options + 24h cooldown

At least 3 option trades by pol-vol-1 in first 5 trading days
